# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large concatenation of real call-center recordings, but **genuine sales/negotiation calls are a minority** — most of the transcripts are internal logistics chatter (truck/vehicle dispatch coordination, loading status, driver call-holds, bill/MTC paperwork follow-ups), personal/unrelated conversations (e.g., the long "Vishal" calls which are casual chit-chat, cricket, family talk — not sales), or very short/garbled fragments with no commercial content. Several "calls" are wrong numbers, voicemails, or scam/unrelated B2B solicitation calls (Amazon business, Uday Panda) that have nothing to do with BSC's own selling.

The real, usable sales signal comes mainly from:
- **Rate-inquiry and quotation calls** with architects/fabricators/traders (Uniqcore Const – Balakrishnan, Vasanth Narasimhan Engg, VASUDEVAN K, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, V R Earth Movers, VIMALADEVI K, Vijayalakshmi Builder, Uniconsys Pvt Ltd Site, Venkatesan, Vel Murugan Eng, Yuvaraj Elumalai).
- **Dealer/transporter rate-and-order calls** for outstation dispatch (Raipur/Bhilai/Nagpur/Vizag) covering TMT and steel sheet loads, trailer/vehicle booking, overload "2-bill" practice (Akash Trailorwala, Ramdev Gulshan, Vizag Duysthan, KV Logistics).
- **Site/quality-complaint calls** around MTC (test certificate), tag mismatch, and material shortage (Uniqcore Const Site Vinoth).

Given this mix, the knowledge base below is built strictly from the commercially meaningful calls; operational-only chatter is excluded. Because true "closing" dialogue is rare and most calls are transactional rate-checks, the playbook is necessarily short and grounded only in what was actually said.

## Products & brand ladder

From the calls, BSC deals in long and flat steel products, sourced both from own plant/stock and from mills/ brokers:

- **TMT rebar** — grades FE 500 / FE 550D / SE 550D mentioned explicitly. One call notes: *"500 கிடைக்காது Sir... 550D தான் Sir வரும்"* [500 not available; only 550D comes] — because R&L (RINL/Vizag) plant was not producing FE500 for 3 months.
- **Structural steel**: ISMB, ISMC, MS angle, MS channel, SHS/CHS pipes, square pipe, flat bars.
- **Plates**: MS plate, HR plate, checkered plate — common thickness talk: 3mm, 4mm, 5mm, 6mm, 8mm, 10-12mm, with standard sheet sizes 2500x6300mm or "4x8", "2.5 to 12" sizing.
- **CR coil sheet** (cold rolled, IS 513 spec) also enquired for (0.6mm thickness, 10 ton order).
- **MS round bars**.
- **Build-up/PEB sections** — enquired but BSC clarified it doesn't supply fabricated/variable build-up sections; only raw material (plate/channel/angle) by weight/size.
- **Binding wire, bolts, hanger bolts** — BSC does not stock these on "sale" (trade) basis: *"angle bolt-லாம் sale-ல பண்ண மாட்டாங்க"* [angle/bolt items aren't made on sale basis].

**Brand ladder** (as described by BSC staff themselves):
- **SAIL ("Sale")** and **Vizag/RINL ("Vizag", tag name "RNL")** are the two primary mill brands — same price band, interchangeable for most items: *"Vaisakh-க்கும் sale-க்கும் difference இருக்காது... ரெண்டுமே same price தான்"* [No price difference between Vaisakh(RINL) and Sale(SAIL), both same price].
- **Tata** is positioned as premium/high-rate: *"Tata-ல கிடைக்கும் pipe. அது rate ரொம்ப high இருக்கும்"* [Tata pipe available but rate very high].
- **NMDC** appears for plates.
- **Apollo** for pipes (branded, vs local unbranded pipe/flat which many SKUs default to): *"இதெல்லாம் local make தான் சார் வரும்... sale wise-ஆ produce பண்ண மாட்டாங்க"* [These items only come as local make; mills won't produce them on sale basis].
- SHS (square hollow section) and tube items are explicitly **not dealt in** by BSC in at least one call ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

Rates fluctuate across the corpus (weeks apart, market-driven), quoted "+ GST" and often "+ loading/transport extra":

- Plate/sheet rates mentioned: ₹59–61/kg (Aug), rising to ₹65.5/kg (Oct, 20-ton sheet enquiry), ₹61–63/kg range (various structural items), ₹54–58.50/kg on a flat-bar negotiation that was finally closed at **₹53.50 "final"** after customer pushback from an initial ask of ₹50-50 matching a competitor.
- TMT: 12mm quoted ₹69, 16mm ₹68.5 (+GST extra) in one site deal; another call cites **₹71,750 / ₹73,750 / ₹75,750** as finalized tiered rates for a construction order (Uniqcore/Balakrishnan thread) — confirmed unchanged across multiple follow-up calls.
- HR plate ~₹66-68 + tax; ISMB/ISMC/angle same ₹65-67 range; MS round ₹65-70.
- Structural (UC) rate ₹75,750 — confirmed stable over several days of follow-up, with small (₹100-200) discount sometimes conceded on transport-inclusive asks.
- CR coil sheet rate example: ~₹64/kg (4ft width) on a "Power Mac" account.
- TMT for Chennai delivery vs Vizag-to-site transport: **₹3,600-3,750/ton** truck hire differentials of ~₹200 between Chennai and Vellore/VIT destinations; Coimbatore transport ~₹4,600/plate-load; Bilai→Chennai approx ₹4,700/ton bulk.
- **GST and loading/transport are consistently quoted as extra**, never included in the "basic rate": *"+ GST + loading transport எல்லாமே extra நான் basic rate"*.
- **Overload/"2-bill" practice**: when truck capacity (32-35 ton) exceeds the declared tonnage, transporters/dealers routinely split into 2 invoices to cover the extra load — repeatedly confirmed as standard practice without objection ("2 bill குடுத்துரலாம் ஒன்னும் problem இல்ல").
- **Payment terms**: Advance payment required before dispatch/cutting in most cases — "amount போட்டாதான் bill குடுப்பாங்க" [bill given only after payment]. Credit given in at least one case for 1 month ("1 month தான் credit"), but default stance is advance.
- **MTC/Test Certificate practice**: original MTC + tag must be couriered after material dispatch; seal + handwritten quantity endorsement required for site acceptance; mismatches (wrong grade tag, SAIL tag vs Vizag material) caused real friction and repeated clarification calls.
- **Weight shortage tolerance**: customers/transport accept up to ~150-200kg shortage per load as normal; anything above (e.g., 300kg) is treated as a genuine escalation requiring owner-level resolution.
- **Small-quantity policy**: New customers are not given small/odd quantities: *"New customer-க்கு எல்லாம் சின்ன சின்ன quantity குடுக்குறது இல்ல sir"*.
- **Cut-length practice**: Standard full lengths are 6.3m/12m; BSC does not like under-cutting short lengths (e.g., "6 meter எப்பவுமே கொடுக்கலையே" — TMT 6m cut refused; full 12m mandatory for certain SKUs) — but cut-to-size is offered elsewhere when price is pre-agreed.

## Objection Playbook

| Objection (Tamil, gloss) | How BSC staff responded |
|---|---|
| *"rate கொஞ்சம் குறைக்க கூடாதா?"* [Can't you reduce rate a bit?] | Hold firm on basic rate, occasionally concede small ₹1-2/kg or transport-only discount: *"₹100-200 கம்மி பண்ணுங்க சார் அவ்வளோதான்"* |
| *"loading charges போடாதீங்க"* [Don't add loading charges] customer accuses sudden policy change
